annotations.title: Reserve a GPU (automatic launch when back in stock)

description: Reserves a GPU machine that is out of stock: GPU Cloud launches the server AUTOMATICALLY as soon as it is back (machines are gone in 1 to 2 minutes), before other customers (first come, first served per machine). Requires a saved credit card (else httpStatus 402 PAYMENT_REQUIRED with the card link: an AI never enters card details), the user's explicit agreement (consent: true) and a maximum hourly price. The automatic reload is not required: the answer carries onFundsExhausted (the action at the threshold, chosen with the onFundsExhausted argument) and, when the reload is off, autoReloadWarning (show its message to the user). At launch, if the balance does not cover the first hour plus the hibernation threshold, only the missing amount is charged to the saved card; then the server is billed by the hour. Nothing is charged when reserving. [SPENDS MONEY] (permission: servers:reserve) [Requires a free GPU Cloud account and MCP key]

acceptAlternative.description: true: an equivalent machine (same usage, at least the same GPU memory, never spot) may be launched when the exact one is not in stock. Default false: this exact machine only.

consent.description: true ONLY once the user explicitly agreed to: "I authorize GPU Cloud to launch this server as soon as it is available, to charge my saved card the amount needed if my balance is not enough, then to bill it by the hour under the terms." (version 2026-10-10). Without it nothing is reserved.

maxHourlyCad.description: Highest hourly price (CAD) the user accepts: at least the current price (gpucloud_get_product), at most 5 times it. Above it at launch time, the reservation waits.

name.description: Server name (letters, digits, space, dot, dash, underscore).

onFundsExhausted.description: What happens to the launched server when the balance reaches its threshold: HIBERNATE (default: kept 12 h with an hourly hibernation fee, restarted when the balance is back) or DELETE (deleted at once, data lost). Spot machines are always DELETE.

productId.description: Exact GPU machine to reserve (model and size, gpucloud_list_products), e.g. one shown out of stock.

sshKeyId.description: SSH key id installed on the server (gpucloud_list_ssh_keys).

templateId.description: Optional one-click template installed at launch (gpucloud_list_templates).

templateModel.description: Model served by the vllm template.

validityDays.description: Days the reservation stays valid (1 to 30, default 7); renewable in the console.

name: gpucloud_reserve_server
